_comment: The Codex model and reasoning effort for each source role (D3=A).
Roles come from plugins/cai/models.json's own 'assignments'; this file
only maps a role name to a Codex slug and effort, applied by
scripts/gen-codex.py's emit(). Ruled out: adding these columns to
plugins/cai/models.json itself, which I1 keeps untouched.
Re-tiering is a one-line edit here, followed by --release; a slug
retired or hidden for an account (C19) breaks dispatch for that user.
